spots.line: A longhouse of green timber, still weeping sap out of the roof beams.
Axes on the wall, hung by men who meant to come back for them.

chests.line: The foreman's strongbox, and the foreman two seasons gone.

people.name: Hask the Axe Bear
chatter: Bruin fells them. I carry them. Nobody writes songs about the carrying.
There is a shield by the door. It is mine. Leave it.

people.name: a caterpillar asleep on the bench
chatter: It takes up the entire bench and nobody has the nerve to say so.
